deduplicationCorrection.backfillNote: Azure Monitor may return revised values for the same native minute in later overlapping polls. The latest capturedAtUtc copy is retained. Transaction native identities had no conflicting point values in the comparison window; VM/disk gauge identities with revised copies are counted in deduplicationStatsComparisonWindow.

commonComparisonWindow.nativeBucketsExpected: 2026-10-13T05:29:00Z through 2026-10-13T05:38:00Z; identical endpoints in both lanes

deduplicationCorrection.method: Native Azure points deduplicated by (resourceId, metric, sorted case-folded dimension-name/value identity, native timestamp). When overlapping polls returned the same identity more than once, retain the row with latest capturedAtUtc; conflicting point values are counted and latest-capture value wins.
deduplicationCorrection.perLaneSelection: Each lane starts after its own executedAtUtc; comparison uses the later of the two receipts as common exclusive start and a fixed 05:38:00Z inclusive end so both runs use the same native minute buckets.
deduplicationCorrection.reason: Previous transaction totals summed overlapping Azure backfilled poll rows. The replacement transaction counts below are summed once per unique native identity/timestamp.
deduplicationCorrection.referenceImplementation: shared/plot_archive_metrics.py::point_identity and load_series use the same Blob native identity and latest-capture selection contract.
deduplicationCorrection.transactionSemantics: Azure Monitor Storage Transactions is request/API-operation count by ApiName and ResponseType; it is not a count of WAL segments or unique archived objects, and PutBlob may comprise multipart/block operations.
